preconditions.description: The number of destinations (nodes) is between 2 and 10^5.
The number of corridors (edges) is between n - 1 and 10^6.
The destinations a and b are within the range of 1 to n.
Destinations a and b are not the same.
The energy requirement e is between 0 and 10^9.
The graph is guaranteed to be connected, meaning there is a path between any two nodes.

postconditions.description: The output consists of m lines, each containing one integer representing E_{max}(c_i) for the i-th Corridor c_i from the input.
